reading.title: Forest structural mediation of hydrological processes and ecosystem multifunctionality: mechanisms, trade-offs, and adaptive management

source.venue: Frontiers in Forests and Global Change

reading.why: It addresses ecosystem service bundles, trade-offs, and hydrological processes that parallel urban water yield and stormwater retention goals.
questions: How do structural modifications alter multiple ecosystem services simultaneously?
What role does environmental context play in scaling hydrological processes?
How do the authors address model uncertainties and hidden underground flows?
reading.check: You cannot establish universal, direct causal links between forest structure and multi-service outcomes from this synthesis alone.
